scope: State Model + Read-Only Validation Orchestrator ONLY. No scheduler, no persistent ledger, no agent dispatch, no prompt renderer, no automatic gate advancement, no Demo/Live execution.
canonical_evidence_sources_reused: src/api/strategy_service.py (list_strategies/get_strategy/has_validation_adapter/get_validation_record) -- ONLY reader used; validation_orchestrator never imports validation_framework.adapters.* directly

the 4 existing validation_framework adapters, reached only through strategy_service: ST_ASIAN_SWEEP_5R_V1 (fx_adapter.py), ST_LIQUIDITY_SWEEP_RETEST_V1 (btc_adapter.py), ST_LARGE_SMC_V1 (large_smc_adapter.py), ST_SESSION_SWEEP_CONTINUATION_V1 (session_sweep_continuation_adapter.py)

design_notes.dependency_injection: derive_status()/derive_all_status() take get_strategy/has_validation_adapter/get_validation_record/list_strategies as keyword-only defaulted params (defaults = real strategy_service functions). Production path is 100% canonical-evidence-derived; tests inject fakes only to exercise fail-closed branches without touching real repo files.
design_notes.gate_derivation: current_gate = first non-PASS gate in the adapter's own reported gate order; furthest_verified_gate = last gate in the unbroken PASS prefix. Gate order/names are never invented -- consumed exactly as returned by the existing adapter.
fail_closed_paths: unregistered strategy_id -> UnknownStrategyError (never a fabricated status)
has_validation_adapter()==True but get_validation_record() returns None (contradictory signal) -> validation_state=EVIDENCE_ERROR
no adapter registered -> validation_state=NO_VALIDATION_ADAPTER (never claims gate/evidence progress that doesn't exist)
design_notes.unimplemented_fields_by_design: dataset_role_status/lineage_status/holdout_status are always NOT_TRACKED_BY_WP1 -- no canonical multi-strategy reader for these exists in the repository today (verified by inventory); reporting anything else would be fabrication. agent_required is always NONE -- WP1 implements no dispatch capability (deferred to AVO-WP7).
